## Where does this belong?

The answer decides the licence: core is MPL-2.0, plugins are MIT.

- [ ] **Core (`dopaminejs`)** — fundamental to the progression/reward model; no external dependencies
- [ ] **New plugin** — extends behavior; can have its own peer dependencies; separate npm package
- [ ] **Existing plugin** — fits naturally alongside another satellite package
